overall_assessment: Modern (2018+) pages and the old 2008 format split cleanly at their headings; most flags are false alarms from thin 2008 source pages. Real problems are one long specialist-education plan swallowed into course_content with its arbeidskrav filed as learning_outcomes, arbeidskrav text left in assessment, and recurring placeholders and noise (language line, UiT Exams link) inside sections.

findings.evidence: Ingen delområder kan tas som enkeltemne, men inngår som en del av 3 års heltidsstudier i spesialistutdanning i klinisk odontologi. BESKRIVELSE AV SPESIFIKKE EMNER
findings.description: The whole 'Om emnet' block (about 11,800 chars: per-subject knowledge goals, clinical skills, etc.) is one course_content row because the page has only one heading. The arbeidskrav text ('Arbeidskrav ... Følgende arbeidskrav må være oppfylt for at spesialistkandidaten skal få ta slutteksamen:') is filed as learning_outcomes and no coursework_requirements row exists. The learning goals inside course_content are not separated from content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: UiT's new-format pages put sub-structure in plain-text paragraphs (e.g. 'Arbeidskrav', 'Kunnskap i Endodonti:') with no heading elements, so sectionize() cannot cut there. The 'Hva lærer du' block holds the arbeidskrav text, so it lands in learning_outcomes by heading.
findings.suggested_fix: Add line-start heading patterns for 'Arbeidskrav' (-> coursework_requirements) in R/section_heading_map.R and allow these in-text heading lines for UiT, and check the 'Hva lærer du' mapping on this page type. Accept the oversized course_content as a source-structure limit otherwise.

findings.evidence: Beskriving av arbeidskrav: Alle studentane skal ha halde eit forebudd munnleg innlegg i seminaret
findings.description: Arbeidskrav (approve/not-approve gates) remain in assessment instead of coursework_requirements. In 2008 plans they sit inside the single 'Eksamensform' paragraph (HIS-1007, BED-2017: 'obligatoriske skal løses og leveres inn ... krav til antall godkjente oppgaver'). In FHO9043 the explanatory paragraph 'Den enkelte emnelærer på studiestedet avgjør på selvstendig grunnlag hvordan et arbeidskrav utformes' is kept in assessment while only the lists reach coursework_requirements. HEL-3050 shows the split can work ('Arbeidskrav:' was cut out), so it is inconsistent.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Splitting of 'Arbeidskrav:' inline labels happens only in some cases (labels at paragraph start); a trailing paragraph after the lists and mid-paragraph 'Beskriving av arbeidskrav' are not recognised.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the inline-label splitter in .clean_sections()/sectionize() to recognise 'Beskriving av arbeidskrav' and 'obligatoriske ... godkjente oppgaver' markers, and to keep the paragraph following an 'Arbeidskrav:' list with coursework_requirements.

findings.description: Many 2008 plans give a reading_list row that holds only a placeholder ('Ta kontakt med instituttet/fakultetet', 'Se hjemmeside.', 'Available on request', 'Kontakt studiekonsulenten for informasjon om tilgjengelige prosjektoppgaver.'). These are not reading lists. The same kind of placeholder fills teaching_methods ('Emnet har varierte undervisningsformer.'). The pre-pass flags (boilerplate, empty, short) are real here but the content is faithful to the source.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The extractor keeps all text under a mapped heading; there is no placeholder filter for UiT's default text.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop rows matching these exact UiT placeholder strings in .clean_sections() (reading_list: 'Ta kontakt med instituttet/fakultetet', 'Se hjemmeside', 'Available on request'; teaching_methods: 'Emnet har varierte undervisningsfomer/-formene'), so the section is absent rather than a fake row. Check against course_plan_spec.md first.

findings.description: On every 2018+ page, the sub-heading 'Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk' (mapped as unmapped sub) and its value ('Norsk', 'English') are appended to teaching_methods (also 'Kvalitetssikring' text in LER-3101). It is the language field, not a teaching method.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The sub-heading is unmapped, so its block is appended to the previous section (teaching_methods) instead of being dropped.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk' and 'Language of instruction and examination' to .drop in R/section_heading_map.R (and 'Kvalitetssikring' likewise), so those blocks are removed rather than appended.

findings.evidence: Everything you need to know about before, during, and after the exam; registration, absence, appeals, and diplomas: UiT Exams homepage
findings.description: The UiT Exams link boilerplate and the exam-logistics table lines ('Oral exam Duration: 45 Minutes Grade: Passed / Not Passed', 'Exams', 'Date: Duration: 15 Minutes') are part of assessment (and of coursework_requirements in BIO-3529). Re-sit paragraphs are kept in English pages ('Re-sit examination') but 'Kontinuasjonseksamen' is dropped in Norwegian pages, an inconsistency.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No cleanup of the standard UiT exam-block boilerplate; the .drop mapping covers only Norwegian 'Kontinuasjonseksamen'.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip the 'Everything you need to know about before, during, and after the exam ...' line in .clean_sections(); map 'Re-sit examination' to .drop like 'Kontinuasjonseksamen'.

findings.evidence: Anbefalte forkunn-skaper: Hvilke forkunnskaper som anbefales, avhenger av masteroppgavens emne.
findings.description: Prerequisite information that is present is not extracted. In LER-3101 'Forkunnskapskrav ... Jf. opptakskrav og progresjonskrav ...' is plain text under 'Om emnet' and is silently lost from course_content with no prerequisites row. In RUS-3950 the recommended prerequisites are filed under teaching_methods because the source puts them in 'Undervisningsform'.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Forkunnskapskrav' appears as a paragraph label, not a heading element, so it is neither split nor mapped; RUS-3950 is a source quirk.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat a standalone 'Forkunnskapskrav' line as a heading for prerequisites in the text-label splitter; optionally move 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper:' sentences out of teaching_methods.

findings.evidence: Valgfritt masteremne. Kan blant annet brukes som støtteemne i historie og religionsvitenskap
findings.description: The old 'Mål' field in ARK-3021 holds the course's role in the programme, not learning outcomes. This is a source quirk affecting a single course; the 'Mål' mapping is otherwise correct for other 2008 plans.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Heading 'Mål' is mapped to learning_outcomes regardless of content.
findings.suggested_fix: No pipeline change recommended; accept as source noise.
